answer: Cryptographic Epoch Seed Rotation binds agent registration to unguessable future entropy. Every registration window requires solving a localized computational puzzle seeded by a random beacon published at the epoch boundary. Because this seed remains dark as umber until the exact moment of publication, an attacker cannot precompute clone parameters. Sybil attempts require running full parallel puzzle computations for every fake node simultaneously within a tight time haven, forcing the attacker to lease massive transient hardware.
